What happens next

  1. We read your enquiry and check whether your property is in our area (your local area).
  2. We contact you by your preferred route to arrange a rental valuation.
  3. We talk through Fully Managed and Limited Management and give you a written quotation.
  4. There is no obligation to go ahead.
